current_api_limitation: Requires repeated collections, metadata and formula-ownership support; do not submit directly to the scalar template API.
export_rules: Use the approved immutable case snapshot and independently validated metadata.
Validate requiredness against business-v1; worksheet blanks are not the policy engine.
Validate joins, one invoice and one currency, line units and positive price bases.
Reject collection overflow; never truncate or insert rows implicitly.
Amounts use configured currency precision; unit prices preserve source precision.
Optional input cells and unused mapped rows remain blank.
Preserve formula cells, formatting, merged ranges, widths and page settings.
Backend verifies calculations before export; Excel recalculation is presentation only.
No macros, external links or user-controlled formula evaluation.
Approval state must be enforced through authenticated distinct actors, never typed workbook names.
sheet_protection: Shipment and Goods guard accidental edits without a password; server formula ownership is authoritative, not Excel protection.
